name: console-mode-explainer
description: Explainer animation for the Console Mode README

scripts.whats-new: remotion render src/index.ts WhatsNew out/whats-new.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/whats-new.mp4 -vf "fps=15,scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=128:stats_mode=diff[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5:diff_mode=rectangle" ../../assets/whats-new.gif
scripts.roadmap: remotion render src/index.ts Roadmap out/roadmap.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/roadmap.mp4 -vf "fps=15,scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=128:stats_mode=diff[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5:diff_mode=rectangle" ../../assets/roadmap.gif
